title: Quickstart landing — interactive hero with architecture strip and updated screenshot set
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Replace the static quickstart hero with an interactive hero that introduces the product in two layers: (1) a clean marketing-facing headline + CTA for new users and (2) an expandable architecture strip that explains the request flow (client → routing/policy → model variant → KV cache → output) for engineering audiences. Scope: hero composition, supporting 3 responsive breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile), an 'architecture strip' micro-interaction, and an updated set of product screenshots (hosted API request, dedicated capacity dashboard snapshot, private VPC connection modal). Constraints: minimal engineering effort for landing page rollout (we must limit new frontend components to an expandable strip + animated microtransitions), maintain <3s LCP for hero, ensure WCAG AA contrast and keyboard/ screen-reader accessibility for the interactive strip. Trade-offs considered: full interactive simulator would provide the best learning signal but increases implementation time and testing surface; instead we are shipping a progressive disclosure strip with layered content and sample token-cost numbers. Deliverables: Figma hero comps (3 breakpoints), annotated design tokens, screenshot checklist & capture recipe, final PNG/WEBP assets exported + accessibility alt copy, rollout A/B test variants (control = current hero, variant A = interactive strip collapsed, variant B = interactive strip expanded by default).
acceptance_criteria: Hero designs delivered in Figma with desktop/tablet/mobile frames and componentized tokens
Architecture strip interaction defined (collapsed/expanded/keyboard focus states) and annotated for dev
Three product screenshots produced: hosted API quickstart response, Dedicated dashboard throughput chart, Private VPC connection modal; all captured with consistent UI scale and realistic data
Assets exported and compressed (PNG/WEBP) with 1x/2x sizes and accessible alt text
Design handoff doc (Confluence) with implementation notes, performance heuristics, and A/B test plan
QA checklist completed: keyboard navigation, ARIA roles validated, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text in hero
